shared_elements: row of repeated vertical strokes/figures along a horizontal line
schematic quadruped animal (A) vs human figures (B) — only broadly 'figural'
horizontal composition organised along a baseline
justification: The only real correspondence is formal: both surfaces show a horizontally extended row of repeated upright elements standing on a common baseline (crew-strokes in a boat versus a procession of figures), and both are single-register, profile-oriented compositions. The depicted content differs entirely — A is a schematic silhouette boat with upturned prow-terminals, a small quadruped and abstract strokes, while B shows naturalistically modelled bearded men in robes carrying bowls and vessels toward a larger crowned figure, with no boat, animal or abstract marks.
